title: EtherCAT PDO Receive
text: Receive data from subordinate device represented by process data object, 1 output; {Network Device Index} sets the etherCAT network identifier, {Signal name} sets the etherCAT device variable name character, {Signal Offset} sets the location in the process of signal data Read-only, {Signal Type} sets the data type for EtherCAT data Read-only: character, {Type Size (bits)} sets the size of EtherCAT data type Read-only, {Signal Dimension} sets the dimension of the signal and {Sample Time} sets the rate at which this block is executed Read-only. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Signal name
params.values: EtherCAT device variable name character vector

params.name: Signal Offset
params.values: Location in the process of signal data Read-only: integer

params.name: Signal Type
params.values: Data type for EtherCAT data Read-only: character vector

params.name: Type Size (bits)
params.values: Size of EtherCAT data type Read-only: integer

params.name: Signal Dimension
params.values: Dimension of the signal Read-only: integer

params.name: Sample Time
params.values: Rate at which this block is executed Read-only: numeric
